info.title: Lestapenna API
info.description: Read-only campaign data for the authenticated web app.

current_year.description: In-world year the campaign starts from.

model.description: Model id as the provider names it.

tier.description: Which of the two groups drives this phase, when one does.

configured.description: Whether this table has stored a key for this provider.

hint.description: Last 4 characters, to recognise which key it is. Never the key.

verify_status.description: Outcome of the last real call or test.

guild_id.description: Discord guild id these settings belong to.

quality.description: Quality group: analyst and writer. Where the narrative quality of the summary is decided.

fast.description: Fast group: metadata, map, chat, narrative filter, reconciliation — and RAG.

effective.description: What every phase resolves to right now, groups expanded.

credentials.description: One entry per provider that needs a key.

ready.description: False when a phase has no usable credential: nothing AI can start.

can_manage.description: Whether the caller may change keys and models. Everyone may look.

quality.description: Null clears the choice and falls back to the instance defaults.

image.description: The model that draws portraits. Null clears the choice.

api_key.description: The API key. Write-only: no endpoint ever returns it.

detail.description: Provider message, trimmed. Never contains the key.

mac_address.description: MAC of the PC. Without it there is nothing to wake.

method.description: Id of the wake method in use.

options.description: Values of the non-secret fields that method declares.

configured_secrets.description: Names of the secret fields already stored. Never the values.

url.description: Base URL of the table's own machine running lesta-penna-ai-server.

model.description: Chosen model among those installed on it. Null leaves the choice to the PC.

auth_token_configured.description: Whether an auth token is stored for it. Never the token.

shutdown_token_configured.description: Whether a shutdown token is stored. Separate from the auth token on purpose: switching a computer off is not the same permission as reading from it.

shutdown_enabled.description: Ask the machine to shut down when a session ends. Opt-in: it is someone's home PC.

engine.description: Own machine, or a cloud model billed to the table's key. Never both: no silent fallback from free to paid.

usable.description: Whether the table can actually transcribe right now.

cloud_usd_per_minute.description: USD per minute of audio on the chosen cloud model. Null on own hardware, or unknown model.

remote_model.description: One of the models installed on that PC. Null leaves the choice to the PC.

value.description: Value of a secret field declared by the wake method. Write-only.

models.description: Model ids installed on that PC.

reason.description: Why the list is empty, when it is. Null when the PC answered.

model.description: The Whisper model currently loaded on it.

status.description: UNREACHABLE is the normal state of a home computer, not a fault.

checked_at.description: When the server asked, in epoch milliseconds.

boot_timeout_ms.description: How long the machine is allowed to take, in milliseconds.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds before it switches off. Null when it will not.

secret.description: Secrets go to the vault and never come back out.

input_per_million.description: Null for phases billed per minute of audio rather than per token.

output_per_million.description: Null for phases billed per minute of audio rather than per token.

cost_usd.description: Null when we do not know the price. Not zero.

resource_intensive.description: Runs on the table's own hardware: time and electricity, not money.

pricing_complete.description: False when at least one phase has no known price: the total is partial.

calibrated.description: True when calibrated on this table's own history rather than global defaults.

model.description: Model id, or a prefix ending in *.

overrides.description: Full set. An empty array clears them.

label.description: Shown next to the name to help choose.

recommended.description: True for the models we suggest for this group.

input_per_million.description: USD per million input tokens. Null when unknown — not zero.

per_minute_usd.description: USD per minute of audio. Transcription models only.

per_image_usd.description: USD per generated picture. Image models only.

runs_on_your_hardware.description: Runs on the table's own hardware: no money, but time and electricity.

transcription.description: Cloud models that turn audio into text.

refreshed_at.description: When the catalogue was last rebuilt. Null while it is still the curated list.

effective.description: Read-only view of what this campaign actually uses.

can_manage.description: Whether the viewer can change the server keys and models.

ready.description: False when a phase has no usable credential.

overrides.description: Per-phase overrides set on this campaign. Models only: keys stay with the server.

agentic_summary.description: Whether this campaign uses the semi-agentic summary pipeline instead of the linear one.

dimension.description: Vector length. Two different ones cannot be compared.

usd_per_million_tokens.description: USD per million tokens. Zero on the table's own hardware.

model.description: Model this campaign indexed with. Null before the first ingestion.

fragments.description: How many fragments are indexed right now.

options.description: What this table could switch to, given its keys and hardware.

estimated_usd.description: What re-embedding everything would cost on the table's account.

failed.description: Fragments left on the old model: invisible to search, not lost.

agentic_summary.description: True for the semi-agentic pipeline, false for the linear one.

audio_minutes.description: Minutes of audio the estimate assumes.

cost_usd.description: Null when the rate is unknown. Never zero for "we do not know".

calibrated.description: True when the figure comes from this table's own past sessions.

runs_on_your_hardware.description: Costs time and electricity rather than money.

reason.description: Why the table cannot transcribe, when it cannot.

effective_model.description: The model this campaign will really use.

cloud_model.description: Cloud model chosen by this campaign. Null means it follows the guild.

remote_model.description: PC model chosen by this campaign. Null means it follows the guild.

usd_per_minute.description: USD per minute of audio. Null on own hardware, or unknown model.

cloud_model.description: Null clears the override and follows the guild.

overrides.description: Full set of per-phase overrides for this campaign. An empty array clears them all.

isPrimary.description: True on the one picture the sheet shows. The others are the gallery.

user_id.description: Discord user id; the identifier used in URLs.

total.description: Total rows matching the query, ignoring limit/offset.

label.description: Enum key, never a translated string — the client owns the wording.

factionShortId.description: short_id of the faction, for linking.

role.description: LEADER | MEMBER | ALLY | ENEMY | CONTROLLED | HQ | PRESENCE | HOSTILE | PRISONER

foundation_description.description: The player-written foundation the AI must not contradict.

email.description: Present only when the requester is the character owner — the one non-lore column on `characters`.

is_manual.description: 1 when a human wrote the event rather than the AI.

total.description: Total rows matching the query, ignoring limit/offset.

alignment_moral.description: Chosen moral alignment key, e.g. GOOD.

alignment_ethical.description: Chosen ethical alignment key, e.g. LAWFUL.

shortId.description: short_id of the NPC or location, so the client can link to it. Null for characters, which have none.

userId.description: Discord user id, for members of entityType "pc".

Total rows matching the query, ignoring limit/offset.

usd_per_eur.description: USD quoted by ECB for one EUR.

fetched_at.description: Epoch milliseconds when the rate was fetched.

invoked_ai.description: False when nothing was started, and nothing will be spent.

is_artifact.description: Joined from artifacts: the item is also a tracked artifact.

artifact_short_id.description: short_id of the matching artifact, for linking.

image.description: Image of the linked artifact, when present.

total.description: Total rows matching the query, ignoring limit/offset.

is_artifact.description: Joined from artifacts: the item is also a tracked artifact.

artifact_short_id.description: short_id of the matching artifact, for linking.

image.description: Image of the linked artifact, when present.

acquired_at.description: Epoch milliseconds when the item was acquired.

session_id.description: Session that most recently introduced or changed the item.

total.description: Total rows matching the query, ignoring limit/offset.

short_id.description: Stable short id of the entity.

is_manual.description: 0/1 — se l'entità è bloccata manuale (ha priorità come survivor).

history_count.description: How many history events are attached.

has_rag.description: True when a RAG *_UPDATE card exists for this entity.

score.description: Similarity score against the suggested survivor (0..1).

id.description: Stable cluster id (a hash of the member short_ids).

short_ids.description: short_ids the user selected from the list.

keep_short_id.description: short_id of the surviving entity (it absorbs the dropped ones).

drop_short_ids.description: short_ids of the entities to merge into the survivor and delete.

description.description: Optional merged description supplied by the user (it overrides).

auto_merge_description.description: When true, merges the bios through the LLM (smartMergeBios) instead of keeping the survivor's.

confirm_manual_merge.description: Explicit confirmation, required when a dropped entity has is_manual=1.

final_name.description: Desired final name for the survivor. If it differs from the current one the survivor is renamed (RAG headers and history are repointed). Defaults to the survivor name.

history_repointed.description: History events repointed onto the survivor.

rag_fragments_deleted.description: Snapshot versions folded into the canonical fragment; their content stays in the chronological timeline.

rag_refs_rewritten.description: Riferimenti RAG riscritti (es. ref inventario, associated_entity_ids).

relations_repointed.description: Relazioni DB ripuntate o consolidate (membri, artefatti collegati, ecc.).

short_id_regenerated.description: True when the survivor's short_id had to be regenerated (a collision).

manual_propagated.description: True when is_manual/manual_description was carried over from the loser.

bio_auto_merged.description: True when the bios were merged through the LLM.

renamed.description: Present when the survivor was renamed (final_name ≠ the current name).

survivor_short_id.description: short_id of the survivor after the merge (it can change if regenerated).

description.description: Description override, used so the diff computes the final value faithfully.

history_repointed.description: The survivor's history events that will be repointed to the new name.

rag_headers_rewritten.description: The survivor's RAG *_UPDATE cards whose header will be rewritten.

drop_short_id.description: short_id of the dropped entity the value belongs to.

verdict.description: kept = the survivor already has the value; discarded = the survivor does not and the dropped entity does (it will be lost without an override); differs = both have one, and the survivor wins.

label.description: Human-readable label of the relationship involved.

action.description: repointed = moved to the survivor; deduplicated = already present and consolidated.

version_count.description: How many chronological versions the row holds (1 for legacy, unconsolidated cards).

action.description: consolidated = version absorbed and preserved in the canonical card's timeline; deleted = fragment genuinely lost; rewritten = reference repointed; kept = canonical card retained.

final_name.description: The final name chosen (defaults to survivor_name).

record.description: Record field diff: for each dropped entity, which fields will be lost or kept.

events.description: History events of the dropped entities that will be repointed onto the survivor.

relations.description: Relazioni DB preservate, ripuntate o consolidate.

rag.description: RAG fragments that will flow into the canonical timeline, stay separate, or have their references rewritten.

abilities.description: Parsed from a JSON-encoded TEXT column.

total.description: Total rows matching the query, ignoring limit/offset.

event_type.description: WAR | POLITICS | DISCOVERY | CALAMITY | SUPERNATURAL | GENERIC

total.description: Total rows matching the query, ignoring limit/offset.

image.description: Image of the linked artifact, when present.

role.description: Role in the party faction. Null for members with no affiliation row — the DM, typically.

hasBio.description: Whether the character has a written bio, without shipping the whole text in a list.

name.description: Name of the faction flagged is_party, falling back to the campaign name.

factionShortId.description: short_id of the party faction, when one exists.

alignmentSource.description: Where the alignment came from: the party faction, or the campaign columns as fallback.

text_provider.description: The model that writes the brief, when the mode uses one.

billable.description: Always true: no image provider runs on the table's own hardware.

pricing_available.description: False when we do not know the rate. That is not the same as free.

reference_count.description: How many selected visual references were included in this quote.

reference_input_cost_included.description: False when selected reference-token rates cannot be estimated; the total is then unavailable.

prompt.description: The description in the user's own words. Required for `prompt` and `mixed`.

references.description: Provider-neutral reference manifest. Takes precedence over legacy `reference_ids`.

guild_id.description: Resolved from the campaign: the notification has to link somewhere.

target_key.description: The public short id — what the URL carries.

target_label.description: The name as it read when the work was asked for.

pricing_available.description: False when the rate is unknown — which is not the same as free.

charged.description: True once the provider answered: from here the money is gone.

expires_at.description: When an unaccepted result is thrown away.

prompt.description: The user's own words, echoed back for a repeat run.

scope.description: `scratch` is kept privately for one durable job, then deleted.

auto_selected.description: Whether the UI should select this candidate before the paid confirmation.

trait.description: Dotted path into the appearance, e.g. `hair.colour`.

quote.description: What the material says, as close to verbatim as it got.

kind.description: Which vocabulary of visible traits applies: a place has no bearing, a sword no temperament.

fields.description: Every field this kind of subject can have, in the order a form should show them. Served so the sheet does not keep a second copy of the list.

manual_fields.description: The fields a person filled in by hand. An analysis fills the rest and never touches these.

appearance.description: The structured traits the image prompt is assembled from.

appearance_text.description: The same traits, rendered for a reader.

personality.description: Temperament, manner and voice — people only.

personality_text.description: Free text when a person wrote it by hand.

confidence.description: The weakest claim in the dossier.

is_manual.description: True when any field was written by hand.

stale_since_session_id.description: The first session that moved past this dossier. Set means "worth redoing", never spends by itself.

billable.description: Always true: the analysis is a real model call on the table's account.

pricing_available.description: False when we do not know the rate. That is not the same as free.

fields.description: Field path to value, e.g. { "eyes": "amber", "weapons": ["longsword"], "hair.colour": null }. Null or empty releases a field back to the AI.

scope_key.description: Empty for a campaign reference; the faction short id, or "<type>:<short id>".

imageUrl.description: Where to fetch the bytes, same signed short-lived path as a portrait.

label.description: Omit to keep the current note; null to clear it.

coverUrl.description: Where the card fetches the cover thumbnail.

provider.description: Provider that will answer, on the user's own account (BYOK).

title.description: Derived from the first question, renameable.

shared.description: Published read-only to the rest of the table.

owned.description: False when another member shared it with you.

total.description: Total rows matching the query, ignoring limit/offset.

title.description: Derived from the first question, renameable.

shared.description: Published read-only to the rest of the table.

owned.description: False when another member shared it with you.

message.description: The Bard answer that was just persisted.

title.description: New title. Empty or whitespace-only is rejected.

shared.description: Publish or withdraw the conversation for the rest of the table.

unseen_count.description: Finished work this person has not looked at yet.

active_count.description: Still queued or running. Zero means nothing is moving.

character_name.description: Name of their character in this campaign, when they have one.

display_name.description: Discord nickname on this server, else the global name. Null when Discord cannot be reached.

enrolled.description: Whether they hold a seat in the campaign. False for someone who has a character here but was never enrolled (or was removed): they show up in the list so a master can put them back.

language.description: Spoken language: drives transcription and summaries.

allow_auto_character_update.description: Whether the AI may update character sheets on its own.

art_direction.description: How this table's generated pictures should look. Null keeps the built-in painterly style.

tarot_arcana.description: The major arcanum the campaign card is drawn as. Never null: a campaign that has never chosen one shows the card it was dealt.

cover_url.description: Where to fetch the cover thumbnail; null when the card shows its sigil.

description.description: Hand-written biography. Setting it marks the sheet manual and shields it from AI rewrites.
Biography shown in the app: AI-generated unless written by hand.

is_manual.description: True when the sheet is hand-written and protected from AI rewrites.

status.description: NO_HISTORY means there is nothing to regenerate from: no AI call is made.

provider.description: Provider that will run it, on the user's own account (BYOK).

invoked_ai.description: False when there was nothing to rewrite.

short_id.description: Five-character short id of the row written.

rag_refs_stripped.description: Riferimenti tipizzati ripuliti dai frammenti superstiti.

media_deleted.description: True when an uploaded image existed and was removed.

name.description: Human-readable name of the deleted entity.

moral_weight.description: Moral weight (-10..10). Only on NPC/PC/faction history.

ethical_weight.description: Ethical weight (-10..10). Only on NPC/PC/faction history.

session_id.description: The originating session, or the card marker (e.g. DOSSIER_UPDATE).

header.description: First line of the content: the canonical header, when there is one.

is_entity_snapshot.description: True when this is the entity's official card rather than a session memory.

total.description: Total rows matching the query, ignoring limit/offset.

number.description: Progressive report number (also encoded in the stored id).

id.description: Zero-padded 6-digit report id / object key suffix.

platform.description: Which platform, so the button can show that platform’s own mark.

url.description: Where it points. Channels with no URL are not returned at all.

active.description: False when the URL exists but does not accept money yet: the UI names the channel without making it clickable.

donations.description: Every channel this instance offers, in display order. Empty when it asks for nothing — a fork that wants no donations configures no URL and the bar shows none.
